# The exact SQL each conformance row executes, one record per line as
# "<category>\t<construct>\t<example SQL>". Regenerated ONLY by
#
#     REGEN_SQL_CONFORMANCE_EXAMPLES=1 cargo test -p ravel-sql --test conformance
#
# and never by the prose document's REGEN_SQL_CONFORMANCE=1. This keeps
# "the registry changed" and "an example's SQL changed" as two separate,
# independently reviewed facts: regenerating docs/sql-conformance.md
# cannot silently change what SQL a row runs (#408).

Clause / operator	CASE	SELECT CASE WHEN value > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM samples
Clause / operator	DATE_TRUNC	SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) FROM samples
Clause / operator	Filter (WHERE)	SELECT ts, value FROM samples WHERE value > 0 ORDER BY series_id, ts
Clause / operator	GROUP BY	SELECT series_id, count(value) FROM samples GROUP BY series_id ORDER BY series_id
Clause / operator	GROUP BY ordinal	SELECT series_id, count(value) FROM samples GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY series_id
Clause / operator	HAVING	SELECT series_id, count(value) FROM samples GROUP BY series_id HAVING count(value) > 2
Clause / operator	IN list	SELECT value FROM samples WHERE value IN (1, 2)
Clause / operator	LIKE	SELECT count(*) FROM logs WHERE body LIKE '%record 1%'
Clause / operator	LIMIT	SELECT ts, value FROM samples ORDER BY series_id, ts LIMIT 1
Clause / operator	OFFSET	SELECT value FROM samples ORDER BY value OFFSET 1
Clause / operator	ORDER BY	SELECT ts, value FROM samples ORDER BY ts
Clause / operator	Projection	SELECT ts, value FROM samples ORDER BY series_id, ts
Clause / operator	REGEXP_REPLACE backreference	SELECT regexp_replace('ab', '(a)(b)', '\2\1') FROM samples LIMIT 1
Clause / operator	count(DISTINCT)	SELECT count(DISTINCT series_id) FROM samples
Clause / operator	date_part(minute)	SELECT date_part('minute', ts) FROM samples
Clause / operator	declared i64 typed aggregate	SELECT sum(dur) FROM logs
Clause / operator	declared i64 typed comparison	SELECT ts FROM logs WHERE dur >= 20

Scalar function	current_date	SELECT current_date FROM samples
Scalar function	current_time	SELECT current_time FROM samples

Scalar function	encode	SELECT encode('a', 'hex') FROM samples LIMIT 1
Scalar function	has_word	SELECT count(*) FROM logs WHERE has_word(body, '1')
Scalar function	label	SELECT label(labels, '__name__') FROM samples WHERE value = 3.0
Scalar function	label_match	SELECT count(*) FROM samples WHERE label_match(labels, '__name__', 'b')
Scalar function	length	SELECT length('résumé') FROM samples LIMIT 1
Scalar function	now	SELECT now() FROM samples
Scalar function	rand	SELECT rand() FROM samples

Scalar function	regexp_replace	SELECT regexp_replace('foo123bar', '[0-9]+', 'X') FROM samples LIMIT 1
Scalar function	reverse	SELECT reverse('résumé') FROM samples LIMIT 1
Scalar function	to_char	SELECT to_char(make_date(2024, 7, 15), '%Y-%m-%d') FROM samples LIMIT 1
Scalar function	today	SELECT today() FROM samples
Scalar function	upper	SELECT upper('ab') FROM samples LIMIT 1
Scalar function	uuid	SELECT uuid() FROM samples
Scalar function	version	SELECT version() FROM samples
Window function	cume_dist	SELECT max(c) FROM (SELECT cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY value) AS c FROM samples)
Window function	dense_rank	SELECT max(d) FROM (SELECT dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY value) AS d FROM samples)
Window function	first_value	SELECT first_value(value) OVER (ORDER BY ts) FROM samples
Window function	lag	SELECT count(p) FROM (SELECT lag(value) OVER (ORDER BY value) AS p FROM samples)
Window function	last_value	SELECT last_value(value) OVER (ORDER BY ts) FROM samples
Window function	lead	SELECT count(nx) FROM (SELECT lead(value) OVER (ORDER BY value) AS nx FROM samples)
Window function	nth_value	SELECT nth_value(value, 2) OVER (ORDER BY ts) FROM samples
Window function	ntile	SELECT max(n) FROM (SELECT ntile(2) OVER (ORDER BY value) AS n FROM samples)
Window function	percent_rank	SELECT max(pr) FROM (SELECT percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY value) AS pr FROM samples)
Window function	rank	SELECT max(r) FROM (SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY value) AS r FROM samples)
Window function	row_number	SELECT max(rn) FROM (SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY value) AS rn FROM samples)
Window frame	avg (moving frame)	SELECT avg(value) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM samples

Table dispatch	both tables (cross-signal)	SELECT * FROM samples JOIN logs ON samples.ts = logs.ts
